name: PHP
description: A small PHP 8.1+ inventory library with plain assert()-based tests and a dependency-free runner; no Composer, nothing is downloaded. The ten template tasks of docs/MODEL_HETEROGENEITY.md, Part 2.

toolchain.name: php
toolchain.hint: The PHP 8.1 or later CLI on the Harbor's PATH

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing class
tasks.prompt: In src/Item.php add a public method `getTotalValue(): float` to the Item class that returns unitPrice times quantity. Give it a docblock like the other members. Keep the existing tests passing (`php -d zend.assertions=1 tests/run.php`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test method and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a public static test method `stockRemoveMoreThanAvailableThrows` to tests/StockTests.php. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units throws InsufficientStockException (src/InsufficientStockException.php). A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in tests/Registry.php. `php -d zend.assertions=1 tests/run.php` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test priceCalculatorApplyDiscountTenPercent fails (`php -d zend.assertions=1 tests/run.php`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In config/legacy_codes.ini change max_code_length from 8 to 12. Change nothing else. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested function, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: TextUtil::truncate in src/TextUtil.php has no tests. Write tests for it as public static methods of a new class Inventory\Tests\TextUtilTests in tests/TextUtilTests.php and register each one in tests/Registry.php. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly maxLength, and the negative paths (null value, maxLength below 3), checking the exception class each one throws. Do not change src/. `php -d zend.assertions=1 tests/run.php` must pass.

mutants.find: throw new LengthException('maxLength must be at least 3');
mutants.replace: throw new InvalidArgumentException('maxLength must be at least 3');

tasks.title: Review a diff with three seeded defects (negative control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source of src/Stock.php. Report every blocking defect.

seeded.description: The loop starts at index 1 and skips the first SKU.
An unknown SKU makes find return null and $item->getUnitPrice() throws Error (member function on null) instead of UnknownSkuException.
intdiv($percentOff, 100) truncates the rate to 0 below 100, so no discount is applied.

tasks.title: Review a correct diff (positive control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source. Report every blocking defect, and only real ones.

tasks.title: Turn a feature request into an armada-plan
tasks.prompt: Turn the feature request below into a plan of missions for this repository.

tasks.title: Lint a diff with seeded style violations
tasks.prompt: Lint the diff below against STYLE.md in this repository. The diff is not applied. List each violation as its own bullet line naming the rule and the code. Do not edit files.

seeded.description: Public method suggest has no docblock (rule 2).
echo in library code under src/ (rule 6).

tasks.title: Summarize a voyage
tasks.prompt: Summarize the voyage record below for the team: what was done, what failed and why, and the durable lessons. Do not edit files.
